title: Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): how to recognize it and what to do
what: This is when the sugar in your blood gets too low. It happens more often to people who inject insulin or take some diabetes pills.
why: Everyone who treats diabetes and their families should know this.
duration: help takes 15 to 30 minutes, and sugar usually rises within 10 to 15 minutes
tell_doctor: If low blood sugar happens often
If you have stopped feeling the start of low blood sugar
If you have had low blood sugar at night or with loss of consciousness

prepare.title: Sweets with you
prepare.text: Always carry fast sugar: glucose tablets, sugar, juice or sweet non-diet fizzy drink.

prepare.title: Glucose meter
prepare.text: Keep it close at home, in your bag and in the car.

prepare.title: Family
prepare.text: Tell your family and coworkers what low blood sugar looks like and how to help.

prepare.title: Plan
prepare.text: Ask your doctor whether you need an emergency injection and how to use it.

bring: A note or bracelet saying "I have diabetes"
steps: Signs: shaking, sweating, strong hunger, fast heartbeat, weakness, irritability
Check your sugar - low is usually below 3.9 mmol/L
Eat or drink fast sugar, about 15 grams of carbohydrate
Check your sugar again after 15 minutes
If it is still low, repeat
When your sugar has risen, eat bread or a normal meal if the next one is far off
If the person cannot swallow or is unconscious, lay them on their side and call your local emergency number
feel: With low sugar it is hard to think - this is normal, follow your plan
After an episode you may feel weak and have a headache
after: Write in your diary when sugar was low and what happened before
Do not drive until your sugar is back to normal
Tell your doctor if it keeps happening - they may change your treatment
red_flags: The person is unconscious or having seizures - call your local emergency number, and give nothing by mouth
Sugar does not rise after two tries
The person is confused, acting strangely and cannot eat on their own

faq.q: Can I raise my sugar with chocolate?
faq.a: Chocolate works slowly because of the fat. Juice, sugar or glucose tablets are better.

faq.q: Why does low sugar happen at night?
faq.a: For example after exercise, alcohol or a skipped dinner. Tell your doctor - they will say what to change.

reminders.text: Before you leave, check: you have your glucose meter and fast sugar with you.
